Moldova , [ d ] officially the Republic of Moldova , [ e ] is a landlocked country in Eastern Europe , with an area of 33,843 km 2 (13,067 sq mi) and a population of 2.38 million. [ 9 ] Moldova is bordered by Romania to the west and Ukraine to the north, east, and south. [ 16 ] The unrecognised breakaway state of Transnistria lies across the Dniester river on the country's eastern border with Ukraine. Moldova is a unitary parliamentary representative democratic republic with its capital in Chișinău , the country's largest city and main cultural and commercial centre.
